svg.text: Feature: Sprint 2 authenticated housing credit journeys
All bank proposals are DEMO; users can only read their own private resources.
✔ Scenario: Profile changes survive a new login and invalid changes do not persist [@US02]
✔ Scenario: Only a valid authenticator code enables the second factor [@US03]
✔ Scenario: Logout revokes the presented token without revoking a second session [@US04]
✔ Scenario: Only the property owner can remove a registered property [@US08 @US07-dependency]
✔ Scenario: An issued DEMO offer creates a private notification that can be read twice [@US10]
✔ Scenario: A received offer keeps one persisted schedule after catalogue deletion [@US11]
✔ Scenario: Normalized tags combine with text and ownership using AND [@US14]
Executed in 3.42s with Cucumber JVM & Spring Boot Test TestContext
